chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 262: The Snare — Han Li vs Ghost Spirit Sect Young Lord
chapter_meta_description: Han Li spots a single dark green nail and realizes the Yan Clan is a Ghost Spirit Sect disguise. He flees at full speed, but the Young Lord’s blood-cloud is faster.
og_title: A Single Dark Green Nail Exposes the Trap — RMJI Ch. 262
og_description: Han Li’s paranoid eye catches an impossible-to-ignore detail, saving him from the Yin Fire Formation. But can he outrun a faster predator?
twitter_title: RMJI 262: That half-inch of green nail just saved Han Li’s life. But the Young Lord is faster.
twitter_description: Han Li identifies the Ghost Spirit Sect Young Lord by his green nail. Divine Wind Boat vs Blood Spirit Grand Art. Who wins?

lore_anchors.definition: The heir-apparent of the Ghost Spirit Sect, a top demonic faction. Known for his silver mask, green robes, and blood-path cultivation.
A large-scale fire-elemental confinement formation that traps all within its boundary; used here as a snare for attending cultivators.
A speed-type flying artifact refined from Ink Flood Dragon materials; extremely fast but has no defensive or passenger capacity.
A high-speed blood-path escape technique that transforms the user into a blood-cloud; faster than most ordinary flying artifacts.
